name: Aku'mai
summary: Aku'mai is a monstrous, three-headed hydra dwelling in the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps along the Zoram Strand. Imbued with primordial shadow and favored by the ancient Old Gods, the beast is revered as a herald of apocalyptic ruin. The Twilight's Hammer cult tends to the creature in its submerged lair, worshipping it as a sign that the Old Gods will soon return.

sections.title: The Scourge of Zoram Strand
sections.body: Long before cultists claimed the sunken temple beneath the sea, Aku'mai haunted the coast of Ashenvale as a living blight upon the Zoram Strand. A creature of deep water and darker powers, this gargantuan hydra carries a fragment of the Old Gods' ancient malevolence within its three ravenous heads. Rather than an ordinary denizen of the tides, Aku'mai is an ancient terror that has lurked in the submerged ruins since the fall of the night elves' temple to Elune, poisoning the waters with Void-tainted malice.

sections.title: A Pet of the Primordial Darkness
sections.body: Aku'mai's foul aura eventually drew the Twilight's Hammer deep into the subterranean caverns. Viewing the hydra as an anointed pet and harbinger of their dread masters, the cult established their sanctum around its nesting ground. Twilight Lord Kelris oversees the hydra's growth, convinced that tending to Aku'mai and its insatiable hunger for living flesh will help usher in the resurgence of the Old Gods.

aliases: what kind of monster is akumai
faq.answer: Aku'mai is an ancient, three-headed hydra infused with dark Void energies. Originating as a favored pet of the Old Gods, it has haunted the Zoram Strand and the submerged halls of Blackfathom Deeps for generations.
Aku'mai resides in the deepest submerged grottos of Blackfathom Deeps, a ruined temple complex dedicated to Elune located along the coast of the Zoram Strand in north-western Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer feeding Aku'mai?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer views Aku'mai as an emissary and herald of their Old God masters. Led by Twilight Lord Kelris, the cultists tend and protect the beast, believing that nourishing it will hasten the return of the Old Gods and reward them with dark blessings.

Beyond its immense physical size and multiple snapping heads, Aku'mai channels shadow and Void energy gifted by the Old Gods. Its presence corrupts surrounding waters and instills madness in those who draw near.

No. Aku'mai is not an Old God, but rather a primordial hydra serving as their favored pet and conduit. It holds a tiny fraction of their ancient dark power, sufficient to drive cultists to worship it.

faq.q: Why do adventurers venture into the deeps to slay it?
faq.answer: Left unchecked, Aku'mai's endless hunger and the cult's devotion threaten to unleash a calamitous evil across Ashenvale and Kalimdor. Both Alliance and Horde authorities seek to put an end to the Twilight's Hammer and slay the horror lurking at the heart of the temple.

angles.text: Aku'mai has defiled the deepest sanctorum of a ruined temple once consecrated to the moon-goddess Elune, turning a holy site into a lair of corruption.
The vile presence of Aku'mai and the Twilight's Hammer represents the direct corruption of the Void against the teachings of the Holy Light and Elune.
Aku'mai's unnatural corruption warps the coastal waters of Ashenvale, demanding cleansing to restore natural balance.
